name: fomc-release
notes: An FOMC statement release at 14:00 ET: four headlines and one econ observation, the news queued and the observation conflated. GENERATED, not recorded, and TESTING §8 is the record of why — the federalreserve.gov FOMC calendar page is one of the four captures still missing from fixtures/providers/raw/, so nothing on disk can be replayed into a release. THE HEADLINE TEXT AND THE ECO_* VALUES BELOW ARE SCENARIO INPUT AND NOT AN OBSERVATION of any release, meeting or decision; they exist to drive the plant and the conflator and no number here should be read as a statement about anything. What the session proves is NEWS-01 against BUS-03: the first headline pays the snapshot debt at the first flush, then three headlines land inside ONE 250 ms window and leave as THREE deltas in publication order, because a latest-value mask would keep the last one and silently drop the other two — while e:DFEDTARU in the same window is conflated as everything else is.
